name: Frost ward
look: Frost ward, an ice barrier from cultivation fantasy. A faceted shell of pale blue ice crystals encloses the character in a tall dome, sharp facets catching cold light, frost mist at its foot.
subject: shield

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: ice crystals grow up from the ground and close over the character into the shell

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the shell holds; cold light glints across the facets and a little frost mist drifts at its foot; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes the shell's right side; white cracks spread from the impact point across the facets, ice chips fly off to the right

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the cracked shell shatters into ice shards that fall and scatter on the ground
